result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): Both answers are well-built single-column mobile layouts with the same card structure and a FAQ built on `<details>`. A comes out slightly ahead: a brand bar tells visitors where they are, it adjusts the featured card's padding so its thicker border doesn't shift the content, and a white band with divider lines makes the FAQ a compact, distinct section. B's hours pill and boxed FAQ items work well, but its featured card is 1px out of alignment, its side margins are tighter at 16px and it has no site context at the top. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Both answers stack three structurally identical cards and put the FAQ after the plans in a sensible order. B's opening view is clearer, with a brand bar and a headline that names the decision, and it reduces the featured card's padding to make up for its thicker border so the cards stay aligned. B's FAQ is also more distinct and compact as a divider list on its own white band, while A styles its FAQ items as cards much like the plans and skips from h1 straight to h3 in the plan cards.
